The house

Four decades under the hood.

Modern Auto Center has spent forty years earning a simple reputation in North York: do the work properly, price it fairly, and send people home with a car that feels right.

We are a Class A shop — Red Seal licensed mechanics who treat every vehicle, domestic or import, car or truck, as if it were our own. No theatre. No upsells dressed as urgency. Just diagnosis, craft, and a clean bill of health.

Class A / Red Seal licensed Certification-grade workmanship on every bay.
Honest, reasonable pricing Fast service without the dealership premium.
Domestic, import, new & used parts If it rolls, we can source it, inspect it, or repair it.
The work

Our services include

From a safety sticker to a full rebuild, from a local repair to a crate of parts crossing an ocean — this is a complete house for cars and trucks.

01

Class A Mechanic

Red Seal licensed diagnostics, engine work, transmissions, tune-ups, and rebuilds — executed to certification standard.

02

Certification Inspection Center

Official safety certification and thorough inspections so your vehicle is legal, sound, and ready for the road.

03

General repairs — Cars & Trucks

Brakes, suspension, electrics, cooling, tires, and everything in between for passenger cars and light trucks.

04

Cars & parts overseas shipping

We source, pack, and ship vehicles and components internationally — a rare capability in an independent shop, handled with the same care as a local repair.

05

Parts for most make & model

New and used parts on hand or sourced quickly — engines, transmissions, brakes, and body components.

06

Insurance claims

We work with your insurer, document the damage, and keep the repair moving so you are not left waiting on paperwork.

The method

From bay to road, without the wait.

A clear sequence. You always know what we found, what we recommend, and what it costs — before a wrench turns.

01

Call or walk in

Tell us the make, the symptom, and your timeline. Same-week appointments are the rule, not the exception.

02

Diagnose with care

Class A inspection — not a guess. We show you what failed and what can wait, in plain language.

03

Repair, certify, ship

Parts fitted, systems tested, safety certified if required. Overseas orders packed to travel.

04

Back on the road

Keys returned, work explained, invoice that matches the quote. That is the entire promise.

The shop

A full house for cars that have to work.

Oakdale Road, Unit 8. A proper bay, not a waiting-room franchise. We keep new and used parts moving, handle insurance files, and still make time for the everyday oil leak that is ruining someone’s week.

Whether you need a safety, a transmission, a crate of components for overseas, or a second opinion after a dealership quote — this is the number to call.
